besluite.fout: 'dit' has no clear antecedent: the nearest noun is 'die pad', which does not work, and it could also be read as the circuit or the device.
besluite.rede: Naming the device fixes an ambiguous pronoun without adding a fact or changing the claim, since the switch controls when the device works, and the sentence stays whole.
Putting the time phrase after 'warm' is normal, natural Afrikaans, so moving it is a sideways change that makes the list item no easier to read.
The AWS lets a three-part compound take a hyphen at its main break to make it easier to read, and 'vastehand-spel' helps a Grade 6 reader see the game's name, so the original is not a fault.
